reviews.author: Kstu SLP mama
reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.body: I love the layout and approach of this app. I’m just starting with the beginner level since I’m out of shape and coming back postpartum. There are multiple workout options to choose from (prenatal, postpartum, senior, beginner, yoga, etc.) looks like you can select a different type of workout any time or select a “program” for it to plan a daily workout for you. At the beginner level it gives me 4 mini workouts each day to choose from and includes a little motivational quote. They are typically between 8-20 min each. (You can do as little or as much as you’d like). Pairs the workout with music or gives options to link to other music apps or silence it so you can play your own. Shows a little animation of each exercise so I can see what I’m supposed to be doing if it’s one I’m less familiar with. Gives countdown warnings before rest interval and switching to the next exercise. In the settings you can adjust the audio on/off to customize. Been just what I need to get going to push myself to start and so far the workouts have been great for toning but haven’t felt too hard to make me feel overwhelmed in starting (beginner level). And since they’re broken down to small pieces I feel much more encouraged to start as a busy working mom because I can sneak in 8 minutes of quick workout time even with the baby crawling around. So affordable also! I got a “discount” price of $30 for the year subscription. Totally worth it. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Linklisa
reviews.title: Exercise that doesn’t judge me
reviews.body: Before the shelter-in-pace, I was going to gentle exercise classes for seniors at the Y. Most of the exercise apps I looked at seemed geared towards people without any of my limitations, or offered very few routines geared only towards seniors. This one is a revelation. I LOVE the wake up stretches workout: who knew you could exercise ON YOUR BED? That allows me to do much more than I could do at the Y, and I can feel how good each stretch is for keeping my muscles in shape. The app has a wide range of workouts (all FREE, with very brief ads) to work on different muscle groups, both stretches and cardio. Clean and useful layout, easy to search. Each workout shows a list of exercises, with clean sketches and links to short videos. When you start, a voice guides you through the timing for each exercise, counting down to start and stop and announcing when you’re halfway through. You can customize the sound to turn off any of these voice features and/or background music. I love that I can choose workouts for my current ability, and see the details of what else I may be able to do as I get stronger. I love that I can follow a good pace, without watching a video that might get boring. I love that the illustrations use simple female figures, so that I don’t focus on body type. I would encourage anyone to give this a chance. If you want an exercise app that doesn’t focus on women, look at the other apps from the same developer.

reviews.author: Redhead4peace
reviews.title: No time? This is the app for you!
reviews.body:
For the longest time, I had trouble getting a consistent workout in. I work 60 to 80 hours in any given week, so working out became on the back burner of my priorities. This app has honestly changed all of that for me. I can’t reason my way out of not having seven minutes to dedicate to myself every day. You don’t get bored because the workouts change every 30 seconds. You can go at your own pace; but I find this system gives you the incentive to push harder. Most times, after the daily 7, I get pumped and do more workouts. Once you get the 8 minutes apart of your routine, it’s much easier to turn it into 15 or 30! The music helps pump you up, except for the yoga ones which help you zone in more. And the boot camps give you a short term goal to meet. I’m not a bot I swear; I just have told everyone I know to download it since I’ve started with it. Try this app, even to add to your routine! You won’t regret it!

The only reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 is because I wish there was a way to connect with friends, like on Facebook, and challenge them. I know some people who like the app, but need even a little more encouragement. If we could see each see when our friends do workouts, send encouragement, maybe even challenge each other to streaks, or do boot camps together for badges, that would be really cool. I’m sure more people I know would get into it if that were the case.

reviews.author: aredford12
reviews.title: Awesome workouts
reviews.body: I really love this work out app!! I had not used it in a long time, when I opened it again they had completely updated and redid the app. And I love the new updates. There is a little bit of everything. If you are new to working out, or have been working out for years no problem there are TONS of beginner workouts and they cover everything from yoga to full body workouts, and they start you out slow and work you up to faster and harder exercises. They cover each part of the body and then some. There are so many I can’t even get a routine or order to start. They make it so easy to find what you are looking for with sub categories. If you are not sure how to do something there is a video that will show how to do that exercise or what ever it is you are doing. There is also a category for programs that you do some many days a week for how ever many weeks. And it again it has a beginners problem as well. We can pay a monthly or yearly subscription to open up everything. There is so much that you can do without a subscription. I would definitely recommend this app to anyone looking for a at home workout app. This is my number one app that I always go too. I have deleted all the others everything I need or would want is right here in this one app. Awesome job to the creators!! Don’t take my word for it try it yourself you will love it.

reviews.author: ekily0339
reviews.title: Great App!
reviews.body:
I don’t usually write reviews, so when I do I usually really enjoy an app, which proves true for this one. I had the app for a couple months and really like it. This review is focused on the new updates that came recently. I am always skeptical of updates (especially because this one was so big for this app), but I really like the new version just as much as the old one. One of my favorite things from the old app was the quotes, and I really like how they made it the first thing you see when you enter the app- it’s a good touch that gets me more motivated for workouts and my day in general. I also enjoy all the new workouts added! While I haven’t had a chance to try all of them yet, I can’t wait to do all the new summer ones that were recently added to the app for the season. I’m glad they kept the original organization of the workouts from the old app, as well as some new categories. I really do notice an improvement of my body and my mood when I use this app vs when I don’t. Getting back on the workouts topic, I really like how they are named specifically so you can choose the workouts for your needs. It makes it really easy for anyone- no matter their skill level- to be able to workout in an easily accessible way. Thanks for the app and keep up the great work! 
**Update** 
They added programs and some new workouts, and I really like the idea! This app really cares about your fitness, and not just making money. I use it everyday, and it makes me excited to work out instead dreading it. I really reccomend this app!

reviews.author: P͜͡U͜͡P͜͡P͜͡Y͜͡S͜͡ !!!
reviews.title: Really Good App !
reviews.body: Ok so overall the app was amazing. I just got this app like a month ago and I don’t usually write reviews but this app is so worth it. So, they will ask you questions like your height and weight etc. but after the questions they give you an option to sign up for premium, and when I saw this I got worried cause I was like oh my gosh if I don’t do it then there will be like no workouts that you don’t need premium for but I was wrong ! They give you tons of options and most of them you don’t need premium! You can even focus on which part of your body you would like to focus on like your abs, thighs, and but and the      best part about it is that you can add workouts to your routine so that you don’t have to try and look through a bunch of workouts trying to find one in particular. I’m pretty sure that no one can see your account but then again I haven’t been using this for long so I could give you a definitive answer. Also, the one bad thing I had to say about the workouts were that they would go really fast sometimes and it was really hard to keep up and I’m not overweight or anything and also some of the exercises were confusing to do because they wouldn’t really give a good illustration of the exercise. If you got this app to lose weight this is prefect for you. It gives you a estimate on when you will meet your weight goal but I’m pretty sure you have to do exercises consistently. Overall this is a great app and I really do recommend to people who feel self conscious about their bodies and are looking for ways to help them feel better about their body instead of starving themselves.

reviews.author: Fastfire2000
reviews.title: The only app that actually works!!!
reviews.body: So I’m a teenager and I’ve tried so many workout apps during quarantine but all of them are just plane boring and I end up not workout out everyday. Those apps are not clear about anything, they tell you to do the workout, I do it and then the next thing I know it charges me 30 bucks per workout. I came across workout for women and omg it’s totally free! I cannot believe I actually feel motivated to do workouts!!! I’ve never felt this motivated, even though I’m very skinny I want to shape my body into the perfect hourglass figure and this app really helps! There are many workouts to choose from under 10 minutes and since we’re in quarantine, I have a lot of free time, so I give myself 6 workouts to do everyday, and that’s how I feel motivated! Not to mention school is coming up soon and I want to look my best 😉 this app gives you quotes every day that motivate you and I love doing the workouts they make me feel like I’m actually progressing! There are workouts for glutes, abs, waist, arms, thighs, legs, back etc. there’s even yoga and morning and night time stretches! This app literally has everything! The only thing I wish it had is more waist workouts but that’s nothing! You can even do workouts for your face and with dumbbells! Unbelievable! Who knew you could do workouts in so many places?? These are very very short workouts that I love to do and I’ve advised this app to almost everyone I know!! You can also choose between beginner, intermediate and advanced workouts! I love this app! ❤️

reviews.author: TheMessyMascot
reviews.title: They make it so easy!
reviews.body: I think a lot of people have wondered about what magic recipe they can use to get themselves into a steady workout routine. This app comes pretty close. I’ve been using it for a little over 2 years now and haven’t had any trouble sticking with it. They have a huge variety of workouts ranging from 4 to 45 minutes, making it simple for beginners to mix and match and scale to exactly what you have time for and can handle. Each move includes an explanation with video instructions if you need it. The timer and countdowns keep you on track and provide little rest periods between moves. You do not need any equipment for most of the moves (a few ask for a chair) but it is easy enough to incorporate weights to increase the difficulty as you improve. You can also pause the routine or lengthen rest times as needed. I usually do my workouts while cooking dinner for my family, using some of the rest times between moves or during longer routines to stir/check the oven. The workouts available in the app cover everything from warmup and cooldown stretches to body-weight strength training to HIIT routines to yoga. They have divided things into sections (eg Arms, Legs, High Intensity, Yoga, etc) to make it easy to build the routine you are looking for. If it’s arm day, just go to the Arms section and pick from the list. I’ve worked my way up from struggling through 10-15 min or so every other day to really looking forward to pushing myself through my 30ish min daily workout and I think the ease and flexibility of this app has a lot to do with it. I recommend this app to everyone and have even gotten my mom into it.

reviews.author: Abby Picar
reviews.title: CONVENIENT
reviews.body:
I love this workout app! It’s the only one that I’ve actually been consistent with because it’s been consistent with me. I utilize the reminder feature as an extra push and motivation for me to work out. My wedding is 7 months away and I don’t have the typical leisure time to go to the gym before or after work, so I love that this app is built for those who would love to get a quick and effective workout in. I’ve been using it for about 3 weeks now, mainly working out for up to 30-40 minutes a day. Surprisingly, I’ve already had about 5 people tell me I’m looking more fit and sexy!! 
One of the many features I love about this workout app is the daily motivational quote that boosts confidence. 
Second, I love the workout options for whatever part of the body I want to focus on. I usually mix and match and will do something like a 20 min workout for abs and then 20 min cardio or whatever I feel like doing. It also has quick 5 minute workouts that you can do at work or at a desk! I end my workout with one of their stretch or yoga options and it’s essential for my cool down because I have respiratory problems. 
Third, I love the tutorial videos linked with the workout lineup! It definitely helps with posture and with good habits! 
Last but not least, I love that I can play any music while working out to any of the programs! It makes it more personal and fun!
